Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Source target_dictionary and component_sequences. Join target_dictionary to target_components via tid, then target_components to component_sequences via component_id. Filter target_dictionary.target_type equals 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
